exclusions.theorem: S14 M2 receives only opaque M1 identifiers, exact fact references, and an unconstructible raster-free lineage receipt; raw raster vocabulary cannot become M2 identity or lease authority.
This tranche makes five producers callable but routes no result into M3+, M4+, or the robot loop; downstream activation requires a separately ratified contract.
Process-local occurrence maps, caches, and counters are optional accelerators only; canonical M0 rows and complete owner snapshots reconstruct every authoritative identity and chain after restart.
The ratified reference model may independently verify the lowering but cannot execute on a production authority path or supply production state.
Conserved non-S14 purpose values remain valid for their existing ports but cannot enter any S14 issuance path or authorize an S14 consumer.

Weak receipts, target-group seals, and denial receipts may preserve exact source relations or typed failure only; they cannot substitute for M0 currentness, survive as canonical fact authority, or mutate entitlement on a failed path.

Process serials, Python object IDs, weak-reference lifetimes, and wall timings may support in-process sealing or cleanup but never determine canonical semantic identity, currentness, replay equivalence, or entitlement.
